about_page.aoi_body: GTMC also operates a dedicated AOI division through AOISystems.eu, helping manufacturers maintain top-level quality standards.
about_page.closing: We are a lean company, and we know how to turn complex requirements into practical software.
about_page.story_p1: GTMC was founded in 2010 and has always focused on enterprise software, with an early specialization in traceability for electronics manufacturers.
about_page.story_p2: Over time, we expanded into access control, process integration and operational dashboards. Working every day with manufacturing companies, we saw how much NPI coordination suffers in spreadsheets and e-mail chains — GTMC-NPI is our answer.
about_page.story_p3: Software development is at the core of GTMC. Thanks to the complementary expertise of the partners, we build robust platforms used by leading industrial companies.
about_page.story_title: A Track Record of Practical Solutions
about_page.subtitle: Since 2010, GTMC builds practical business software in Arad: traceability, access control and now an NPI platform designed for manufacturers launching new products.
about_page.team_body: Our strength is our people: specialists who excel in their domains, with professional experience reaching up to 35 years in the field.
about_page.territory_body: Our headquarters is in Arad, Romania, a region that over the last two decades has attracted major global electronics manufacturers and a vibrant ecosystem of suppliers and technology partners.
about_page.territory_title: Located in a Strategic Industrial Hub
about_page.title: About Us

benefits.analytics_desc: Open projects, late tasks, budget exposure and launch readiness are always up to date.
benefits.analytics_result: Launch decisions taken on facts, not on the loudest opinion in the room.
benefits.audit_desc: Customer audits and IATF certification ask for evidence. GTMC-NPI gives it in a few clicks.
benefits.business_desc: Time saved on chasing status and rebuilding Gantts goes to engineering and to customers.
benefits.compliance_audit_desc: Who changed what and when, for every task, document and decision.
benefits.compliance_bottom_desc: Traceability becomes a by-product of daily work instead of a separate project.
benefits.compliance_docs_desc: Specifications, evidences and checklists generated and archived with versions.
benefits.compliance_gdpr_desc: Data on your server, access by role, retention periods and audit trail.
benefits.compliance_intro_p1: GTMC-NPI is developed in Romania for manufacturers running NPI launches and change requests. The process rules are modelled in the application: milestone readiness, blocking rules, decision authority, versioned configuration.
benefits.compliance_intro_p2: When your process changes, you version the configuration and freeze it — your team does not have to rebuild its spreadsheets.
benefits.compliance_reges_desc: Every milestone keeps its readiness, its blocking rules and its decision snapshot.
benefits.cta_desc: Book a demo and we will show the launch process that takes the most coordination in your company today.
benefits.cta_title: Ready to see what GTMC-NPI can do for your NPI teams?
benefits.digital_hr_desc: Specifications, test reports and approvals are generated, validated and archived digitally in the project.
benefits.discipline_desc: Every launch follows the same steps every time, with owners and deadlines.
benefits.discipline_result: Tasks are executed in order; nothing is discovered missing at the gate.
benefits.modularity_desc: Start with projects and tasks, add readiness gates, budget approvals or the IATF profile when you need them — the data is already there.
benefits.overview_p1: An NPI team works with project plans, task dependencies, budget approvals, quality checklists and customer audits at the same time. Spreadsheets and e-mail chains make every one of these obligations harder to prove.
benefits.overview_p2: GTMC-NPI keeps one project record, turns the launch process into checklists and gates, and keeps the evidence of what was done and when.
benefits.page_subtitle: Less time chasing status, fewer surprises at the gates, project files ready for any audit.
benefits.quality_desc: Late tasks, expiring documents and missing evidences are listed before they block a gate.
benefits.quality_result: Fewer delayed launches and fewer emergency meetings.
benefits.traceability_desc: Every change to a task, document or decision is dated and attributed to a user.
benefits.traceability_result: Fast answers to auditors and customers.
benefits.visibility_desc: Engineering, quality, purchasing and management work on the same project data instead of exchanging files.
benefits.visibility_result: Fewer errors and no more “which version is correct?”.

footer.about_text: GTMC-NPI runs the whole launch of a new product on one controlled workflow: projects, tasks, readiness gates, documents, budget and change management.

fp_budget.card: Budget requests per project, approval workflow and NRE costs in one ledger.
fp_budget.claim: Every euro of the launch approved, traced and comparable with the plan.
fp_budget.intro: The NPI budget starts from the task plan: material costs, tooling, NRE and tests become requests with an amount, an owner and an approver. Nothing is spent that was not requested, and nothing requested is lost in a chat.
fp_budget.s1_body: Material, tooling, NRE and test costs are requested per project and per task, with the currency and the supplier.
fp_budget.s2_body: Approvers accept or reject per line or in total; every decision is stored with its snapshot of the request.
fp_budget.s3_body: Requested, approved and actual amounts per project are always comparable, including the NRE share.
fp_budget.s4_body: Every approval and rejection is dated and attributed — the evidence auditors ask for.
fp_budget.summary_text: A launch budget that engineering and finance read from the same numbers.

fp_capacity.card: Standard times per task, sub-tasks and workload by department and by line.
fp_capacity.claim: Know who has to do how much work before you promise a launch date.
fp_capacity.intro: Capacity turns the task plan into a workload view: standard times per task, sub-tasks where the work is detailed, and the resulting load per department, line or test equipment.
fp_capacity.s1_body: Standard times are configured per task type and reused on every project; overrides are tracked.
fp_capacity.s2_body: Break a task into sub-tasks when the work needs to be assigned and measured in detail.
fp_capacity.s3_body: Workload per department and per week, so bottlenecks appear before they delay the launch.
fp_capacity.s4_body: Actual hours from executed tasks close the loop between plan and reality.
fp_capacity.summary_text: Launch dates promised on real capacity, not on optimism.

fp_change.card: Change requests with questionnaire, scope, readiness and Decision Authority on the same workflow as NPI.
fp_change.claim: A change is decided like a launch: with rules, not with opinions.
fp_change.intro: From the V3 to the V4 of a product, every change follows the same controlled path as an NPI project: questionnaire, confirmed scope, readiness of the change milestones, decision of the Decision Authority, blocks respected.
fp_change.s1_body: The requester answers a guided questionnaire; the scope is confirmed before any task is executed.
fp_change.s2_body: The change has its own milestones and its readiness, calculated by the system like in NPI.
fp_change.s3_body: The Decision Authority accepts or rejects with the readiness snapshot attached to the decision.
fp_change.s4_body: Changes linked to the NPI projects they modify, so the impact is visible on both sides.
fp_change.summary_text: One controlled workflow for NPI and change, without a second tool.

fp_checklist.card: Quality checklists per project, with mandatory points, evidences and quality approval.
fp_checklist.claim: The same checklist for every launch, signed and archived.
fp_checklist.intro: The checklist module mirrors your quality procedure: control points per phase, mandatory evidences, quality approval before a gate can pass. Nothing is marked done because someone said so.
fp_checklist.s1_body: Checklist templates per product family or customer, versioned like the rest of the configuration.
fp_checklist.s2_body: Every point keeps its state, its evidence and its date; mandatory points block the gate.
fp_checklist.s3_body: Quality accepts or rejects the evidences; rejections reopen the point with a comment.
fp_checklist.s4_body: The completed checklist is archived with the project and exports to PDF for the customer.
fp_checklist.summary_text: No more free-text claims of readiness: every launch carries its signed checklist.

fp_common.cta_subtitle: Book a demo or start the free 14-day trial on your own server.
fp_common.cta_title: Want to see this module live?
fp_common.legal_disclaimer: References are given for orientation. GTMC-NPI supports the process but does not replace certification or legal advice.

fp_dashboards.card: Late tasks, expiring documents, budget exposure and launch KPIs at a glance.
fp_dashboards.claim: The numbers management asks for, without building them in Excel.
fp_dashboards.intro: Dashboards show what needs attention today, reports answer the questions of management and auditors, KPIs follow the launch after production start.
fp_dashboards.s1_body: Open projects, late tasks, expired documents and pending approvals on the first screen.
fp_dashboards.s2_body: Readiness per gate, budget plan vs actual, workload per department, KPI after launch.
fp_dashboards.s3_body: Every report exports to Excel or PDF.
fp_dashboards.s4_body: Overdue tasks, expiring documents and pending decisions in one list, optionally by e-mail.
fp_dashboards.summary_text: Clear indicators for NPI managers and management, always up to date.
fp_dashboards.title: Dashboards & KPI

fp_documents.card: Specifications, evidences and reports with versions, hashes and permission-checked downloads.
fp_documents.claim: The right document version, with proof that nobody replaced it.
fp_documents.intro: A launch produces dozens of documents in many revisions. GTMC-NPI keeps every version, hashes it on upload, and serves downloads only through the API with permission checks.
fp_documents.s1_body: Templates for specifications, test plans and checklist documents, generated from the project data.
fp_documents.s2_body: Every upload keeps its version, its SHA-256 hash, its author and its timestamp.
fp_documents.s3_body: Task owners attach evidences to their tasks; quality reviews them before the gate.
fp_documents.s4_body: Downloads go through the API only: who can see which document is decided on the server, not in the interface.
fp_documents.summary_text: An audit can reconstruct every document of the launch: versions, authors, approvals.
fp_documents.title: Versioned documents

fp_gantt.card: Interactive Gantt with dependencies, milestones and the critical path of every launch.
fp_gantt.claim: The whole launch on one timeline you can act on.
fp_gantt.intro: The Gantt is generated from the task plan, not drawn beside it: move a task and its dependents follow, milestones hold their gates, delays are visible the moment they happen.
fp_gantt.s1_body: Tasks and milestones with dependencies, zoom from days to months, drag to replan.
fp_gantt.s2_body: The critical path highlights the tasks that decide the launch date.
fp_gantt.s3_body: Every change keeps its author and its date — the history of the plan is part of the project.
fp_gantt.s4_body: Baselines let you compare the approved plan with the current reality at any time.
fp_gantt.summary_text: A plan that stays true: what you see is what the team executes.
fp_gantt.title: Interactive Gantt

fp_gates.card: Milestone readiness calculated by the system, blocking rules, decision snapshots for gates G0–G5.
fp_gates.claim: Nobody declares a gate ready — the system proves it.
fp_gates.intro: Each gate of the launch (G0 to G5) has its readiness computed from the tasks, documents and checklist below it. Blocking rules are binary, the Decision Authority decides with the readiness snapshot attached, and the decision is stored.
fp_gates.s1_body: Readiness = tasks completed with date + documents approved + checklist points signed. Never typed by hand.
fp_gates.s2_body: Rules like “no open red tasks” or “budget approved” are configured per profile and evaluated on every request.
fp_gates.s3_body: Accept, reject or postpone with a reason: every decision stores the readiness it was based on.
fp_gates.s4_body: Prorogations follow the same discipline: requested by one role, approved by another, both recorded.
fp_gates.summary_text: Gates G0–G5 that an auditor can verify task by task, decision by decision.
fp_gates.title: Readiness & gates G0–G5

fp_iatf.card: Optional IATF 16949 rule profile: stricter gates and additional evidences for automotive launches.
fp_iatf.claim: The same workflow, tuned for automotive requirements.
fp_iatf.intro: The IATF profile is a frozen, versioned rule set on top of the standard one: additional mandatory documents, stricter blocking rules and the quality approvals automotive customers expect. It helps conformity — it does not certify you.
fp_iatf.s1_body: Switch per project: standard profile or IATF profile, chosen when the project is created.
fp_iatf.s2_body: IATF projects require additional evidences and approvals at their gates; the system tracks them.
fp_iatf.s3_body: Only requirement numbers are referenced, never the text of the standard.
fp_iatf.s4_body: Profiles are versioned and freezable: what the project used stays visible years later.
fp_iatf.summary_text: Automotive launches on the same controlled workflow, with the discipline IATF audits expect.
fp_iatf.title: IATF 16949 rule profile

fp_notifications.card: E-mail and Teams notifications on three levels, sent by the worker on schedule.
fp_notifications.claim: The right person informed before the deadline, not after.
fp_notifications.intro: Deadlines alone do not move tasks — people do. The notification service sends e-mails from your SMTP and messages to Teams channels, on three escalation levels, driven by the scheduled worker.
fp_notifications.s1_body: Task owners are reminded before their due date, not the day after.
fp_notifications.s2_body: If a task stays open, the reminder escalates to the project owner and then to management.
fp_notifications.s3_body: Gate decisions, budget approvals and document expirations notify the responsible roles automatically.
fp_notifications.s4_body: Weekly overviews per audience: project owners on Monday, commercial summaries on Friday.
fp_notifications.summary_text: The launch moves because the right people know — on time, every time.
fp_notifications.title: Multi-level notifications

fp_projects.card: Projects and waves with owner, scope, status, statistics and automatic closure when everything is done.
fp_projects.claim: Every launch of the company in one register, from idea to production start.
fp_projects.intro: The project is the heart of GTMC-NPI. Scope, owner, team, milestones, tasks, documents and budget live in one project record that every other module reads from.
fp_projects.s1_body: Scope confirmed by the NPI manager, team assigned by role, waves to structure big launches.
fp_projects.s2_body: Statistics, late tasks and costs per project on one screen.
fp_projects.s3_body: When all assigned tasks are completed with date, the project closes automatically and the completion e-mail goes out. Reopening is a tracked, deliberate act.
fp_projects.s4_body: Multi-company ready: every record carries its company, filtered by the backend on every request.
fp_projects.summary_text: One reliable project register replaces the folders, the Excel files and the questions about the real status.
fp_projects.title: Projects & waves

fp_tasks.card: Task library, assignments, dependencies and evidences uploaded by the owners.
fp_tasks.claim: Everybody knows what to do, by when, and proves it.
fp_tasks.intro: Tasks come from a versioned task library, are assigned to owners with due dates and dependencies, and close only with a dated completion and, where required, an evidence.
fp_tasks.s1_body: Standard tasks per launch type, maintained once and reused on every project — never retyped.
fp_tasks.s2_body: Each task has one owner; dependencies hold the sequence and feed the Gantt.
fp_tasks.s3_body: Task owners upload their evidences (test reports, photos, documents) directly on the task.
fp_tasks.s4_body: Who executes a task can never approve its quality evidence — the segregation is enforced by the backend.
fp_tasks.summary_text: Tasks executed in order, evidenced and auditable — the base of every readiness gate.
fp_tasks.title: Tasks & dependencies

gdpr_page.title: GDPR — how we handle your demo request data
gdpr_page.subtitle: Short notice under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 for anyone sending a demo request through this site.
gdpr_page.controller_body: GTMC CONSULTING SRL is the data controller. For any privacy question write to help@gtmc-npi.eu.
gdpr_page.data_body: Only what you enter in the demo form: full name, email address, company, VAT/CUI number, phone number and the optional message. Nothing else, no third-party tracking on the form.
gdpr_page.purpose_body: To contact you and schedule the demo, and to verify the requesting company through its VAT/CUI number. We do not use this data for marketing unless you give separate explicit consent.
gdpr_page.basis_body: Your consent: you give it by ticking the GDPR box in the form and you can withdraw it at any time by writing to us, without affecting processing already carried out.
gdpr_page.retention_body: Requests not confirmed through the email link are deleted within 30 days. Confirmed requests are kept as long as needed to organize the demo and in any case no longer than 24 months.
gdpr_page.recipients_body: Nobody outside GTMC. Demo request data is never sold or handed over to third parties.
gdpr_page.rights_body: At any time you can ask for access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability or objection by writing to help@gtmc-npi.eu: we answer within 30 days. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority (in Romania: ANSPDCP, www.dataprotection.ro).
gdpr_page.note_body: Submitting the form requires the GDPR box to be ticked: consent is free, but without it we cannot get back to you. If you want your data deleted before the terms above, just send an email.

hero.subtitle: The launch of a new product involves dozens of tasks, dependencies, documents, approvals and decisions. GTMC-NPI takes all of them onto one controlled workflow: milestone readiness is calculated by the system, blocking rules are respected, and every decision is traceable. You focus on the product, the system runs the process.

privacy_page.eu_charter: Charter of Fundamental Rights of the EU (Articles 7 and 8)
privacy_page.legal_intro: Below are the main legal texts relevant to data protection, communications privacy, and network and information systems security.
privacy_page.measures_body: We apply risk-based security controls including encryption of communication channels, access control and role segregation, logging and audit trails, patch and vulnerability management, backup and business continuity, and incident and personal-data-breach procedures.
privacy_page.note_body: This page outlines the general privacy and security approach of GTMC and of the GTMC-NPI platform. It may be updated when legal, organisational or technical conditions change.
privacy_page.principles_body: GTMC processes personal data according to lawfulness, fairness, transparency, data minimization, accuracy, storage limitation, integrity and confidentiality principles. Processing activities are configured with privacy by design and privacy by default.
privacy_page.purposes_1: performance of pre-contractual and contractual measures;
privacy_page.purposes_2: compliance with legal and regulatory obligations;
privacy_page.purposes_3: security protection, business continuity and abuse prevention;
privacy_page.purposes_4: handling commercial requests and customer support;
privacy_page.purposes_5: service improvement based on legitimate interest or consent where required.
privacy_page.purposes_intro: Depending on the context, data may be processed for:

security_page.benefits_p1: GTMC-NPI runs on your own intranet: project data does not leave your infrastructure. Only the license check reaches our server, and it contains no project data.
security_page.benefits_p2: Role-based access, task owners limited to their assignments, encrypted connections and an audit trail on every task, document and decision protect confidentiality, integrity and availability.
security_page.benefits_p3: We provide robust tools, but security is a shared responsibility: use strong passwords, follow access policies and review user permissions regularly.
security_page.benefits_title: Protect Project Data Without Slowing NPI Down
security_page.cta_subtitle: See how GTMC-NPI combines GDPR compliance and day-to-day usability for NPI teams.
security_page.summary_text: Data on your server, access by role, every change logged and RSA-signed licenses. We do our part — you keep strong passwords and sound access practices.
security_page.title: Security & GDPR

seo.about_desc: About GTMC: since 2010 we build practical enterprise software in Arad, Romania — traceability, access control and now the GTMC-NPI launch platform.
seo.benefits_desc: Why GTMC-NPI: one project record, readiness gates proven by the system, blocking rules respected, budget approvals and audit-ready evidences.
seo.default_desc: GTMC-NPI runs the whole launch of a new product on one controlled workflow: projects, tasks, readiness gates G0–G5, versioned documents, budget and change management. Milestone readiness is calculated by the system.
seo.demo_desc: Request a free GTMC-NPI demo and see how your teams can run projects, readiness gates and budget approvals in one place.
seo.features_desc: GTMC-NPI modules: projects and waves, tasks and dependencies, interactive Gantt, readiness gates, versioned documents, budget approvals, quality checklist, notifications, change management, IATF profile, capacity and KPI dashboards.
seo.home_desc: GTMC-NPI runs the whole launch of a new product on one controlled workflow: projects, tasks, readiness gates G0–G5, versioned documents, budget and change management. Milestone readiness is calculated by the system.
seo.pricing_desc: GTMC-NPI pricing: Professional and Enterprise annual licenses plus a free 14-day trial. Prices in EUR, VAT excluded.
seo.requirements_desc: GTMC-NPI system requirements: Windows Server or Linux, Microsoft SQL Server (Express is enough), Python 3.11+ runtime, IIS reverse proxy and modern browsers on the intranet.
seo.security_desc: GTMC-NPI security: data on your own intranet server, role-based access, audit logs, RSA-signed licenses and GDPR-oriented design.

stats.processes: Launch processes covered end to end

leave: Rebuilding the Gantt in Excel every time a task slips, and e-mailing it around.
The Gantt follows the tasks: move one, its dependents move with it.
Chasing owners by phone and e-mail to know the real status of a task.
Owners complete with date and evidence; the status is simply true.
Preparing gate reviews by hand, hoping nothing is missing.
The readiness of every milestone is calculated from tasks, documents and checklist.
Arguing at the gate about what was really approved and by whom.
Every decision stores its snapshot: accept, reject or postpone, with a reason.
Digging through folders and inboxes for the right document version.
Every document keeps its versions, hashes and approvals in the project.
Discovering budget overruns after the invoice arrives.
Requested, approved and actual amounts per project are always comparable.
sv.gain_p1: One NPI manager can coordinate several launches in parallel, calmly and without the fear of a gate failing on a forgotten task. The reports you need are obtained by opening the dashboard — readiness, late tasks, budget, KPI.
sv.gain_p2: Everything runs on your intranet, so your project data never leaves the company. No programming knowledge is required to configure it: task library, milestones and rule profiles are maintained in the application.
sv.gain_ai_q: Which tasks are blocking the G3 gate of the V4 launch?
sv.gain_ai_a: 3 tasks, all overdue. The list, with owners and missing evidences, is ready.
sv.partner_title: A faithful partner, not just a program
sv.partner_text: GTMC-NPI checks everything that must be checked, documents everything that must be documented, and keeps order where spreadsheets used to reign.
sv.price_hook: All of this, for less than the cost of a few hours of engineering coordination per month.
sv.tagline: GTMC-NPI: discipline for you, confidence for your customers.

terms_page.s10_body: These terms are governed by Romanian law. Disputes are settled amicably or, failing that, by the competent courts at the Provider's registered office.
terms_page.s1_body: These terms govern the use of the gtmc-npi.eu website and of the GTMC-NPI platform (the “Software”) between GTMC (the “Provider”) and the company that registers an account or purchases a license (the “Customer”). By deploying, installing or using the Software, the Customer accepts these terms.
terms_page.s2_body: The Provider grants the Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the Software for its own internal NPI and change activity, for the duration, number of projects, users and installations stated in the license. The Software is licensed, not sold.
terms_page.s3_body: The trial license is free, lasts 14 days, is limited to 3 active projects, 5 users and one installation and is intended for evaluation only. At the end of the trial the Software stops working until a paid license is activated; data entered remains in the Customer's database.
terms_page.s4_body: The Software is activated with a license key and periodically verifies the license on the Provider's server. The check transmits only the license key, a technical fingerprint of the installation, the host name, the application version and the number of projects and users — no project data. Servers without internet access can be activated offline.
terms_page.s5_body: The Customer may not copy, modify, decompile or redistribute the Software, circumvent the license mechanism, or use it beyond the purchased limits. The Customer is responsible for the accounts it creates and for the confidentiality of its passwords.
terms_page.s6_body: The Software runs on the Customer's infrastructure and stores data in the Customer's SQL Server database. The Customer is the controller of the personal data it enters and remains responsible for backups. When the Provider gives remote support with access to data, it acts as processor under a data-processing agreement.
terms_page.s7_body: Paid licenses are annual and are invoiced in advance according to the price list or the accepted offer. Without renewal, the license expires at the end of the period; after a tolerance period shown in the application, the Software switches to read-only.
terms_page.s8_body: During a valid license the Customer receives updates, and support by e-mail at help@gtmc-npi.eu, within the response times of the purchased plan.
terms_page.s9_body: The Software is provided as described in its documentation. The Provider is not liable for indirect damages, lost profits or data loss caused by missing backups. The Provider's total liability is limited to the amount paid for the license in the last 12 months. The Software supports NPI processes but does not replace certification or legal advice.
